parameters.content:
## Free public funding research
Execute once to read the current published evidence. No account, API key or model required.

Retains source dates, data quality and counterevidence. Research only; no order or message is sent. No automatic retry. Add a schedule only at the cadence you need and respect rate limits.

[Agent kit and source](https://liquilens.in/agents/)
